title: Partial answers: right idea, one piece missing in every beat
goal: Give a right-but-incomplete answer in every beat and keep it that way after Rebecca's one follow-up: Jamie facts only, summary result only, Chloe talk plus what she did but no next step, Dylan training only.
must_hit: One follow-up per beat at most
Story moves on after the follow-up

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you plan to do about Jamie
intents.do: Facts only, no her side, no standard, and keep it that way after a follow-up
examples: I'd write down that the mistakes happened, six weeks out of eight.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll put in the summary
intents.do: Result only, no team work, even after a follow-up
examples: I'd show how many customers we kept.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'd say to Chloe
intents.do: Private talk and what she did, no thing to try
examples: I'd talk to her privately and tell her she cut in on the client call.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll do about Dylan
intents.do: Training only, no date or check-ins
examples: I'd get him some training on the software.
